title: Pause strip no longer covers the planet bar
description: The pause switch under a question an ability asks itself (here Bio-Stims) floats at the bottom edge and lay over the planet chips of the planet-selection bar (nightly 2026-10-20, runs o4-74-0200 and o1-105-0312). While the strip is shown it now publishes its height as --prompt-strip-room and the bottom-anchored bars lift by it. Before shots re-apply the old layout by cancelling that lift; after shots are the real app. Capture asserts with elementFromPoint that no planet chip is covered.

shots.heading: Before (390x844)
shots.caption: The strip covers the planet chips.

shots.heading: After (390x844)
shots.caption: The bar sits above the strip; every chip is reachable.
